description:
[Taxonomy II.22 — baseline response (public data only)] For a given ICD-10, surface the CPT codes typically billed for that diagnosis.

WHEN TO USE: User has an ICD-10 diagnosis and wants to know what CPTs are commonly billed for it.

WHEN NOT: For planning specific services (use benchmark_payer_rate once the CPT is chosen).

EXAMPLES:
- Common CPTs for essential hypertension: `{"icd10_code":"I10"}`

icd10_code.description: Single ICD-10-CM code, e.g. 'I10'. Returns common CPT candidates.

name: icd_to_cpt_mapper
